# BUSINESS IDENTITY

> Cascade Clean Pros is an owner-operated residential and commercial
> pressure washing and soft washing company serving King and Snohomish

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT WE DO (primary answer block)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

Cascade Clean Pros provides exterior surface cleaning for homes,
commercial properties, and industrial facilities across the greater
Seattle–Everett corridor in Washington State.

Residential services include house washing (soft wash), driveway and
concrete cleaning, deck and patio cleaning, walkway and hardscape
cleaning, and fence cleaning.

Additional services include roof cleaning and moss treatment (low-pressure
soft wash only — never high-pressure on shingles), gutter cleaning and
downspout clear-out, concrete sealing, and deck and fence staining.

Commercial services cover apartment and multi-family properties,
retail storefronts, industrial and warehouse facilities, office and
medical parks, restaurants and food-service operations, and fleet and
equipment washing.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# SERVICE AREA
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

Primary service area: King County and Snohomish County, Washington.

Cities served: Lynnwood, Edmonds, Mill Creek, Everett, Mountlake Terrace,
Mukilteo, Marysville, Lake Stevens, Snohomish, Monroe, Bothell, Woodinville,
Kenmore, Kirkland, Redmond, Bellevue, Shoreline, Seattle, Sammamish, Issaquah.

For larger residential and commercial projects, Cascade Clean Pros is
available beyond this primary service area. Contact for availability.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

Q: What is the difference between pressure washing and soft washing?
A: Pressure washing uses high-pressure water and is suited for hard
surfaces like concrete, driveways, and pavers. Soft washing uses
low-pressure water combined with specialized cleaning solutions and
is used on delicate surfaces such as painted siding, stucco, wood,
and roofing shingles. Cascade Clean Pros selects the correct method
for each surface on every job.

Q: Does Cascade Clean Pros serve Seattle?
A: Yes. Cascade Clean Pros serves Seattle and surrounding cities across
King and Snohomish Counties, including Bellevue, Kirkland, Redmond,
Shoreline, Bothell, Kenmore, Woodinville, Sammamish, and Issaquah.

Q: Does Cascade Clean Pros serve Everett, Lynnwood, and the North Sound?
A: Yes. Cascade Clean Pros serves the Snohomish County corridor including
Everett, Lynnwood, Edmonds, Mukilteo, Mountlake Terrace, Mill Creek,
Marysville, Lake Stevens, Snohomish, and Monroe.

Q: Will pressure washing damage my roof or siding?
A: Not when performed correctly. Cascade Clean Pros uses low-pressure
soft washing for roofs, siding, and other delicate surfaces. High-pressure
washing is reserved for concrete and hardscape only. Surface condition is
assessed before work begins.

Q: Does Cascade Clean Pros handle stormwater compliance on commercial jobs?
A: Yes. Cascade Clean Pros uses biodegradable cleaning solutions and follows
Washington Department of Ecology and county stormwater guidelines, with
water-capture practices on commercial projects.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Submit the online request form at https://cascadecleanpros.com or call
(360) 202-7249. Cascade Clean Pros responds within one business hour, and a
free on-site assessment and written estimate follow at no obligation.

Q: Is Cascade Clean Pros owner-operated?
A: Yes. Cascade Clean Pros is independently owned and operated.
